title: WorkplaceSuggestion
description: One office offered while typing in a workplace search box. Only offices with at least one listed lawyer are offered, so every suggestion returns results.

name.description: The office's name as stored in the workplace table

city.description: The office's city, to tell branches of one firm apart. Absent when not recorded.

lawyerCount.description: How many listed (non-archived) lawyers work at this office
